_comment: D-pad key sequences per TV screen, with settle times. Data only -- WP-TV-SHELL's scripts/tv-walk.ts (its own package, not this one) is the intended replay/capture driver; see docs/UI-LOOP.md. Key names match tools/ui-shots/android.ps1's $TvKeys table (adb shell input keyevent). settleMs is how long to wait after the LAST key in a step before a screencap is meaningful (focus animation / data fetch), not a wait per key.
